season.evidence: SummitPost says reasonably climbable May-October with early snow over lower brush; Mountaineers runs it in summer; logged East Face ascents Jul and Aug, reports Jul 3 to Sep 13. Stored Jul-Sep kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Aug 31 round trip from Stehekin passing within 9 m of the summit, but the same trip includes Devore, the report names no face, and the approach is Devore Creek not our Company Creek text; not a clean single-route track.
Sep 13 combined Tupshin plus Devore, start and end are in the valley; report describes flake pitches only.
Jul 4 partial recording starting mid-slope (about 5,000 ft), no trailhead, no report.

facts.text: Most parties in July to September go in by the Devore Creek trail to the Bird Creek camp near 5,400-5,500 ft, then fight slide alder up to a basin camp around 5,800 ft; easy slopes lead to a ridge near 7,000 ft, then a descending traverse to the snow basin east of the summit block.
In July and early August a snow patch or firm snow in the basin below the face must be crossed to reach the first ramp.
Loose rock on the upper face sends stones down onto parties below; avoid climbing beneath other teams.
Plan on four or five rappels to get back to the base, with a large anchor below the summit block.
Cams from 0.75 to #2 for the flake pitches; most of the rest was scrambled

notes: Our approach text (Company Creek trail, White Goat west slopes) differs from what all in-season reports did (Devore Creek trail and Bird Creek). Summit pin matches Peakbagger. No trailhead pin added: no confirmed coordinate.
